card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a long drug or medical word, such as the nis in prednisone, act in prolactin, or c in hypoglycemia. Also fires on day numbers in chemotherapy schedules.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name or clinical term that is not yet finished.

modes.label: Day numbers in dosing schedules
modes.description: A day number in a list of treatment days for chemotherapy.
